educationalGoal: Students will learn about general education on electrical and electronic engineering that is necessary for GX (Green Transformation) and DX (Digital Transformation). Electrical and electronic engineering consists of six areas of learning: Power & Energy, Electric Machines & Controls, Energy Materials & Devices, Optical Devices & Semiconductors, Information and Communications & Electromagnetic Waves, and Acoustics & Imaging. Students will acquire the general education to understand electrical and electronic engineering news through the course objectively.
advice: The course is an omnibus-style course given by six professors. The course provides an overview of electrical and electronic engineering, which is necessary for the GX and DX technologies. This course will offer the starting point for the electrical and electronic engineering exploration journey.
requiredKnowledge: This is a liberal arts course for all departments, therefore no specific prior knowledge or skills are required.
